cases.lens: 2 conditions: concept ROE→roe + pattern เกิน→above (0.20); concept รายได้→revenue + pattern โตทุกปี→consecutive_growth (N=3)
cases.acceptance: Resolves roe+above(0.20) AND revenue+consecutive_growth(N=3); one screen_unified call, non-empty plausible list (high-ROE consistent growers). Client fills threshold 0.20 + N 3. No fabrication.

cases.question: หุ้นถูกๆ P/E ต่ำกว่า 15 ที่กำไรขั้นต้นกำลังขยายตัว
cases.lens: concept P/E→pe + pattern ต่ำกว่า→below (15, NOT a fraction); concept กำไรขั้นต้น→gross_margin + pattern ขยายตัว→expanding/accelerating
cases.acceptance: Resolves pe+below(15) AND gross_margin (or gross_profit)+an expanding/accelerating shape; one call, plausible list. P/E threshold sent as 15 (not 0.15). No fabrication.
